msDesc.head: Guardbook of fragments, comprising leaves from at least 11 different Greek manuscripts; 15th–17th century.

physDesc.p: Guardbook of fragments, comprising leaves from at least 11 different Greek manuscripts, dating from the 15th to the 17th century. supportDesc.support: Paper. Watermark: angel with countermark BC, very similar to Briquet 667 (Vicenza, 1598); the countermark BC is also similar to Briquet 9447 (Reggio d’Emilia, 1597).

handDesc.handNote: Written in a minuscule hand in brown ink. The titles and initials of the oracular verses are in cinnabar-red ink, partly overpainted at a later date.

decoDesc.decoNote: Coloured illustrations accompanying Oracles I–XV. The illustrations were probably produced towards the end of the 16th century, perhaps on Corfu (Kerkyra). For a detailed description, see Irmgard Hutter, Corpus der byzantinischen Miniaturenhandschriften, I-III, Oxford, Bodleian Library, 3 vols. in 4 (Stuttgart, 1977–82), ii, 7 [Internet Archive] .

history.provenance: The manuscript of the Oracles circulated as a separate booklet, as indicated by heavy soiling and abrasion on fol. 266r, formerly its first leaf, and fol. 268r, formerly its last leaf. It belonged to the deacon Theophanes on Corfu and subsequently to an Italian owner.
